description: A livecoding sequencer running the ORCA language: letters typed into the grid are operators that build patterns and send MIDI and CV as the frame counter advances.

params.text: Sets the speed of the internal clock, 30 to 300 beats per minute, when nothing is patched to the clock input.
Starts and stops the simulation; the space bar does the same.
Advances the simulation by one frame on each press.

inputs.text: A trigger advances the simulation by one frame, in place of the internal clock.
Read by the CV read operator: a numeric read maps 0-10V onto the values 0 to 35, and a pitch read gives the semitone of a volt-per-octave voltage.
A trigger resets the frame counter to zero.

outputs.text: Carries a trigger on every frame of the simulation.
Written by the CV write operator: a numeric write maps the values 0 to 35 onto 0-10V, and a pitch write gives a volt-per-octave voltage.

notes: a voltage written as a pitch can carry a gate length, after which it returns to 0V; without one it is held.
the grid is empty on a new instance and produces nothing until operators are typed into it or an example is loaded from the menu.
menu: Examples — loads one of the embedded ORCΛ tutorial patterns straight into the grid.
MIDI — Driver enabled and Driver pick the MIDI output; Virtual driver enabled and Virtual choose the virtual port that other MIDI modules can then select.
Clear, Load from file, Inject file, Save to file and Save selection to file — read and write the grid as a text file; Ctrl with N, O, B and S do the same while the grid is selected.
Undo, Redo, Zoom in and Focus mode — Focus mode fills the screen with the grid, and Shift and Escape leaves it.
Terminal — sets the grid's size with the Rows and Cols sliders, and the spacing of its guide marks with Grid step cols and Grid step rows.
Randomize selection — Sparse (10%), Medium (30%) or Very dense (50%), filling the selected part of the grid with random operators.
UDP and OSC — set the address and port the ORCΛ send operators write to, taken up by Apply.
CC range 0-35, CC range 32-67, CC range 64-99 and CC range 96-127 — under MIDI, setting which control changes the CC operator writes to.
Help — Learn ORCΛ, ORCΛ cheat sheet, ORCΛ online manual and ORCΛ GitHub repository each open a page in a web browser.
